criteria.text: FDA-labeled use in the Alaska Medicaid Elevidys criteria.
Patient meets FDA labeled age: 4 through 5 years (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neuromuscular specialist (approval criterion 2).
Patient has a diagnosis of Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (approval criterion 3).
Patient has a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene (approval criterion 4).
For a mutation in exons 1-17 and/or 59-71, prescriber will monitor for immune-mediated myositis and has a mitigation strategy in place (approval criterion 5).
Patient does not have a deletion in exon 8 and/or exon 9 of the DMD gene (approval criterion 6; denial criterion 4).
Patient anti-AAVrh74 total binding antibody titer is <1:400 (approval criterion 8).
Patient is not on concomitant DMD-directed antisense oligonucleotides and has not received one in the past 30 days (approval criterion 9).
Patient is currently on a stable corticosteroid regimen per FDA labeling guidance (approval criterion 10).
Prior to administration, patient has had liver function tests (ALT, AST, GGT, ALP, total bilirubin, INR) AND Troponin-I (approval criterion 11).
Patient has no clinically significant active infection (denial criterion 2).
Patient has no acute liver disease (denial criterion 3).
Patient has not previously been treated with gene therapy for DMD (denial criterion 5).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Elevidys (delandistrogene moxeparvovec-rokl), an AAV vector gene therapy for DMD, Criteria Version 1: Original 09/21/2023; Approved 11/17/2023; Effective 01/1/2024. The effective_date remains 2024-01-01.

Encoded: the closed FDA-labeled indication in this PDF, approval criteria 1-11, and approval-blocking denial exclusions. DMD diagnosis, confirmed DMD gene mutation, and current ambulatory status are separate attestations despite overlap with the indication. Denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria; exon 8/9 deletion is covered once by approval criterion 6.
Duration (notes only): initial approval 3 months; no reauthorization will be approved.

LFT monitoring (notes only): at baseline prior to therapy, weekly for the first three months following administration, and thereafter as clinically indicated. Acute liver injury has been observed, frequently within 8 weeks of administration.
Cases of immune-mediated myositis have been observed. Monitoring and mitigation for mutations in exons 1-17 and/or 59-71 are encoded as a conditional attestation.

Myocarditis has been observed following administration. Monitor Troponin-I prior to administration, weekly for one month following, and thereafter as clinically indicated (ongoing schedule notes only).

The PDF describes accelerated approval based on expression of ELEVIDYS micro-dystrophin in skeletal muscle. Continued approval may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trial(s).

Quantity limits, approval duration, no reauthorization, and ongoing monitoring schedules require attestation/manual review and are not fully predicated; this pack remains partial. Baseline labs are attested as completed, without numeric lab predicates.
No Elevidys or delandistrogene match was found in the ingested PDL; pdl_status remains unknown. No evaluate-linked alternatives are specified.
